description: Auto-emit a data profile per materialization. Global: row_count, column_count. Per column: dtype, null_count, null_ratio, distinct_count; for numerics: min/max/mean/std; for categoricals (< N distinct): top_value_ratio. Optional custom_probes for extensions. Profile emitted as AssetObservation with typed MetadataValue — searchable in Dagster event log, drift detection is free (compare over time). Companion `@profile` decorator wraps existing @dg.asset.

outputs.description: One @dg.asset. On every materialization: computes DataFrame profile, emits AssetObservation with full profile JSON + typed metadata on the materialization.

categorical_max_distinct.label: Categorical Max Distinct
categorical_max_distinct.description: Cols with <= this many distinct values get top_value_ratio.

top_n_columns.label: Top N Columns
top_n_columns.description: Profile only first N columns (very wide DataFrames).

name: Profile Asset
